name: lily-design-system-angular-motion-picker
description: Lily Design System Angular 20 motion (reduced-motion) picker: an icon button opening an APG listbox that sets data-motion on the document, defaulting to the OS's own prefers-reduced-motion signal. Headless, SSR-safe, no CSS.
